# Hybrid codec authority fixtures

Copied byte for byte from the reviewed proposal
`openspec/changes/add-hybrid-p256-codec/fixtures/`. `manifest.json` holds the
SHA-256 of every other listed file here, and `scripts/verify.py --hybrid-codec`
pins the manifest's own SHA-256, so nothing here may change silently. Nothing
is fetched or regenerated by the gate.

- `hybrid-runtime.json`: the deployed Polygon (chain 137, block 95559460)
  MetaMask delegation-framework v1.3.0 `HybridDeleGator` runtime and its
  genuine linked SCL library runtime with their original addresses and
  Keccak hashes, plus a locally built pinned OpenZeppelin `ERC1967Proxy`
  creation code (solc 0.8.23, shanghai).
- `upstream/`: the relevant unmodified sources at revision
  `bfbdf9795a976833ed2fa000baf42fbb83958b03` (`HybridDeleGator.sol`,
  `P256VerifierLib.sol`, `P256SCLVerifierLib.sol`) for review only; they are
  not compiled.

These are offline EVM runtime fixtures, not deployment, Secure Enclave or
device evidence.
